## Which signal separates serious from not serious (Cal.com + Sentry, 134 Opus findings)

Serious = matched a golden (49) or audited real-defect (34): 83. Not serious = audited real-minor, wrong or unverifiable: 51.
AUC: chance that a random serious finding ranks above a random not-serious one (0.5 = coin, 1.0 = perfect).

| Signal | AUC, both | AUC, Cal.com | AUC, Sentry |
|---|---|---|---|
| Wachiman severity | 0.784 | 0.834 | 0.770 |
| Wachiman severity, then confidence | 0.786 | 0.810 | 0.793 |
| Opus scorer score | 0.832 | 0.864 | 0.798 |
| Haiku scorer score | 0.825 | 0.865 | 0.782 |
| Haiku echo within 10 lines | 0.634 | 0.607 | 0.643 |
